summary_zh: 外交部表示，尼泊尔一侧受灾地区失联中国公民近百人，目前正全力搜救。
summary_en: The Chinese Foreign Ministry said nearly 100 Chinese citizens are missing in the disaster-hit area on Nepal's side, and rescue efforts are in full swing.
